benchmarks.name: LexBench Web Fetch
benchmarks.description: Compare live-site retrieval on real websites, from URL to usable content.

metrics.label: Task success
metrics.description: Share of evaluated cases that meet their task-specific pass criteria. The published percentages are retained as supplied. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Request success
metrics.description: Share of requests that returned a response. A response does not guarantee that the content meets the task requirements. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Total mean
metrics.description: Mean total elapsed time reported in the supplied table, in milliseconds. Lower is better.

metrics.label: Total P50
metrics.description: Median total elapsed time (50th percentile), in milliseconds. Lower is better.

metrics.label: Total P95
metrics.description: 95th percentile of total elapsed time, in milliseconds. Lower is better.

categories.name: Dynamic
categories.criterion: The target JavaScript-rendered content is present.

categories.name: Popular
categories.criterion: Main content, item counts and link counts meet the thresholds.

categories.name: Anti-bot
categories.criterion: The target page is returned instead of a challenge page.

categories.name: Documents
categories.criterion: PDF and DOCX titles and body text are recovered.

categories.name: Embedded media
categories.criterion: Valid image or video links embedded in a web page are returned.

categories.name: Direct media
categories.criterion: The downloaded media file matches the original.

metrics.label: Task success
metrics.description: Share of evaluated cases that meet their task-specific pass criteria. Failures and timeouts count as unsuccessful. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Request success
metrics.description: Share of requests that returned a response. A response does not guarantee that the content meets the task requirements. Higher is better.

categories.name: Dynamic
categories.criterion: The target JavaScript-rendered content is present.

categories.name: Popular
categories.criterion: Main content, item counts and link counts meet the thresholds.

categories.name: Anti-bot
categories.criterion: The target page is returned instead of a challenge page.

categories.name: Documents
categories.criterion: PDF and DOCX titles and body text are recovered.

categories.name: Media
categories.criterion: Valid image or video links are returned. Includes 3 direct-media cases whose files must match the originals.

benchmarks.name: LexBench WebMainBench
benchmarks.description: Compare Markdown main-content extraction using the same frozen HTML pages.

metrics.label: Overall
metrics.description: Mean score across full text, code, formulas, table content and table structure. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Full text
metrics.description: Quality of full-text extraction compared with the reference content. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Code
metrics.description: Quality of code extraction from the page. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Formulas
metrics.description: Quality of mathematical formula extraction. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Table content
metrics.description: Quality of extracted table-cell text and data. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Table structure
metrics.description: Quality of preserved table rows, columns and cell structure. Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: LexBench Web Search
benchmarks.description: Compare search retrieval on fixed scenario queries for agents.

metrics.label: nDCG@5
metrics.description: Measures relevance and ranking quality in the top 5 results. More relevant results earn more credit at higher ranks. Shown on a 0–100 scale.

metrics.label: Avg. response
metrics.description: Mean response time in seconds. The measurement scope and sample count are recorded with each result.

metrics.label: Price / 1K
metrics.description: Published price per 1,000 calls, in USD.

metrics.label: Precision@5
metrics.description: Share of the top 5 results with relevance grade 2 or 3. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Success@5
metrics.description: Share of queries with at least one top-relevance result (grade 3) in the top 5. Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: LexBench SimpleQA Verified
benchmarks.description: Compare search retrieval on short factual questions.

metrics.label: Hit@5
metrics.description: Share of questions with at least one annotated reference page in the top 5 results. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Avg. response
metrics.description: Mean response time in seconds. The measurement scope and sample count are recorded with each result.

metrics.label: Price / 1K
metrics.description: Published price per 1,000 calls, in USD.

metrics.label: MRR@5
metrics.description: Mean reciprocal rank of the first reference-page hit in the top 5: rank 1 scores 1, rank 2 scores 0.5, and a miss scores 0. Range: 0–1. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Answer Match@5
metrics.description: Share of questions whose reference answer matches a title or snippet in the top 5 results. Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: LexBench Headless Browser
benchmarks.description: Compare Moli builds with layout on and off on a 372-task subset of the LexBench Headless Browser protocol, measuring success, memory and latency.

metrics.label: Task success
metrics.description: Passed tasks divided by the total number of evaluated tasks.

metrics.label: Success Δ
metrics.description: Change in percentage points against the Moli 1.1.4 baseline with layout off.

metrics.label: PSS
metrics.description: Peak proportional set size (PSS) during execution, in MiB.

metrics.label: PSS Δ
metrics.description: Percentage change in PSS against the baseline.

metrics.label: Mean latency
metrics.description: Mean latency per task, in milliseconds.

metrics.label: Latency Δ
metrics.description: Percentage change in mean latency against the baseline.

benchmarks.name: LexBench WebArena Replay
benchmarks.description: Compare browser execution on fixed action trajectories for 812 WebArena-Verified tasks.

metrics.label: Task success
metrics.description: Passed WebArena-Verified tasks divided by the total number of evaluated tasks.

metrics.label: Task mean
metrics.description: Mean end-to-end task latency across evaluated tasks.

metrics.label: Task P50
metrics.description: Median end-to-end task latency across evaluated tasks.

metrics.label: Task P95
metrics.description: 95th percentile of end-to-end task latency across evaluated tasks.

metrics.label: Action mean
metrics.description: Mean latency per action. The sample count is the number of actions executed by this setup.

metrics.label: Action P50
metrics.description: Median action latency. The sample count is the number of actions executed by this setup.

metrics.label: Action P95
metrics.description: 95th percentile of action latency. The sample count is the number of actions executed by this setup.

benchmarks.name: LexBench SWDE
benchmarks.description: Compare structured field extraction on 800 archived SWDE pages across eight domains.

metrics.label: Page-hit macro F1
metrics.description: Macro-average page-hit F1 as published in the supplied evaluation. Values remain on a 0–1 scale; the detailed matching and aggregation protocol was not supplied.

metrics.label: Executed / planned
metrics.description: Executed pages out of the planned evaluation pages. This is execution coverage, not extraction correctness.

metrics.label: Pages with fields
metrics.description: Pages for which the method returned fields. Returning fields does not imply those fields were correct.

metrics.label: Value micro F1
metrics.description: Value-level micro-average F1 as published in the supplied evaluation, on a 0–1 scale. The detailed normalization and matching protocol was not supplied.

metrics.label: Field-set exact
metrics.description: Published field-set exact-match rate. This is distinct from all fields and values being correct on a page; the detailed denominator and field-matching protocol were not supplied.

metrics.label: Full-page exact
metrics.description: Pages with a fully correct extraction among pages eligible for full-page scoring. Pages with incomplete reference coverage are excluded; this is not a rate over all executed pages.

metrics.label: Null handling
metrics.description: Correct empty-value handling on the published null-handling subset. The numerator and denominator are shown alongside the supplied rate.

metrics.label: Timed pages
metrics.description: Executed pages with a recorded timing measurement.

metrics.label: Untimed pages
metrics.description: Executed pages without a recorded timing measurement. Lower is better.

metrics.label: Mean time
metrics.description: Mean elapsed time in seconds across the recorded timing measurements.

metrics.label: P50 time
metrics.description: Median elapsed time in seconds across the recorded timing measurements.

metrics.label: P95 time
metrics.description: 95th-percentile elapsed time in seconds across the recorded timing measurements.

benchmarks.name: LexBench Zyte Product Extraction
benchmarks.description: Compare price, SKU and stock extraction from 140 archived product pages.

metrics.label: Full-page exact
metrics.description: Pages where all evaluated product fields are correct. The supplied numerator, denominator and percentage are shown together.

metrics.label: Tested / total
metrics.description: Tested pages out of the total evaluation pages. Coverage does not imply extraction correctness.

metrics.label: Returned objects
metrics.description: Number of product objects returned by the method. An object being returned does not imply that its fields are correct.

metrics.label: Price F1
metrics.description: Published F1 for price extraction, on a 0–1 scale. The reference population for the selected version is recorded below.

metrics.label: SKU F1
metrics.description: Published F1 for SKU extraction, on a 0–1 scale. The reference population for the selected version is recorded below.

metrics.label: Stock F1
metrics.description: Published F1 for stock availability, on a 0–1 scale. The reference population for the selected version is recorded below.

metrics.label: Out-of-stock F1
metrics.description: Published F1 for out-of-stock detection, on a 0–1 scale. This is separate from Stock F1; the reference population for the selected version is recorded below.

metrics.label: Null handling
metrics.description: Correct empty-value handling on the supplied subset, shown as count / total and percentage. This is not a rate over all product pages.

metrics.label: Timed pages
metrics.description: Tested pages with a recorded timing measurement.

metrics.label: Untimed pages
metrics.description: Tested pages without a recorded timing measurement. Lower is better.

metrics.label: Mean time
metrics.description: Mean elapsed time in seconds across the recorded timing measurements.

metrics.label: P50 time
metrics.description: Median elapsed time in seconds across the recorded timing measurements.

metrics.label: P95 time
metrics.description: 95th-percentile elapsed time in seconds across the recorded timing measurements.
